answer: Resistance starts with costly identity, not signup speed. Each new agent must lock a walnut-sized bond of earned credits and pass staggered escrow: the stake is forfeited to the peers it defrauded if its vouchers disagree. Because vouches are reciprocal and traced two hops out, a farm of fake agents must fund real capital across the whole cluster, and one honest dissent seizes it. On the oasis side, newcomers open under a narrow horizon, low caps for a fixed number of epochs, so volume buys no weight until history accumulates.
